description: E-Dash schema v3 bootstrap. Create missing documents only. Based on SETUP_README.md and provisioning defaults, 2026-10-27.

printables.description: Per-document defaults for SF10 requests and outgoing envelopes. Save each printables.<kind> map with mergeFields to preserve unrelated toggles and other document preferences.

enrollmentStatus.description: Enrollment status selected as ACTIVE or INACTIVE. Transfers and dropouts are recorded separately through transfer flags and EOSY status.

documentStatus.description: Selected category: Successfully Transmitted, Transmitted, Preparing Documents, Received Documents, Emailed, or Custom. SF10 email tracking sets Emailed only after Gmail confirms sending for this learner in this school year. An empty string displays No Documents Received. Legacy Successfully values and dates remain readable.

documentStatusCustom.description: Custom Document Status label. Existing legacy transfer notes are retained and offered as Custom when no newer status is recorded.

documentStatusDates.description: Date-only YYYY-MM-DD values keyed by Document Status category, including Emailed. Successful SF10 email tracking fills the Emailed date using Philippine time and preserves other category dates. Each category retains its own date when the selected category changes.

teacherComments.description: Teacher comments in term order, defaulting to three strings, with an optional fourth string for four-term school years. Saved per learner and school year, retained in archives, and used to prefill learner cards and the parent portal.

attendance.description: Monthly non-negative decimal day counts (or empty strings), keyed by Card Preferences month labels. Add/edit forms calculate daysAbsent as classDays minus daysPresent; daysAbsent is read-only. Stored per learner and school year and retained in archives.

anecdotalRecords.description: Verified anecdotal or conduct records saved with each learner and used for Good Moral certificates. Also retained in dropout and transferred-out records.

transferSchoolId.description: Required school ID when Transfer In or Transfer Out is selected. Store as text to preserve leading zeros.

transferSchool.description: Required source school name for Transfer In or destination school name for Transfer Out.

transferSchoolAddress.description: Required source/destination school mailing address for transfer records.

transferSchoolZipCode.description: Required source/destination ZIP code for transfer records. Store as text to preserve leading zeros.

slots.description: Up to three metadata entries keyed signature-1, signature-2, signature-3. Each contains label, revision, width, height. Asset bytes are stored separately.

assignments.description: Allowed signature slot IDs for each printable. A missing or empty list disables signatures for that printable.

label.description: Signature position label up to 80 characters (for example Principal, Registrar, or Teacher). Existing label field remains compatible.

width.description: Prepared PNG pixel width, at most 1208.

height.description: Prepared PNG pixel height, at most 608.

storage.description: New images are uploaded to Cloudinary; Firestore stores only the delivery reference and metadata.

url.description: Bounded HTTPS PNG delivery URL on res.cloudinary.com/<cloudName>/image/upload/. Cached in memory as a data URL only for print/export.

publicId.description: Cloudinary public_id returned by the unsigned upload.

cloudName.description: Cloudinary cloud name at upload time, retained so existing signatures work if the build configuration changes.

format.description: PNG preserves signature transparency. Incoming transformations that crop, resize, or flatten the image are rejected.

dataUrl.description: Legacy only: inline transparent PNG up to 220000 characters. Still readable; the admin Move to Cloudinary action replaces it with a Cloudinary reference and preserves printable assignments.

transferSchoolId.description: Required school ID when Transfer In or Transfer Out is selected. Store as text to preserve leading zeros.

transferSchool.description: Required source school name for Transfer In or destination school name for Transfer Out.

transferSchoolAddress.description: Required source/destination school mailing address for transfer records.

transferSchoolZipCode.description: Required source/destination ZIP code for transfer records. Store as text to preserve leading zeros.

transferSchoolId.description: Required school ID when Transfer In or Transfer Out is selected. Store as text to preserve leading zeros.

transferSchool.description: Required source school name for Transfer In or destination school name for Transfer Out.

transferSchoolAddress.description: Required source/destination school mailing address for transfer records.

transferSchoolZipCode.description: Required source/destination ZIP code for transfer records. Store as text to preserve leading zeros.

adviserOverride.description: Set true when an administrator explicitly edits the displayed adviser in School Structure. This saved name takes precedence over linked account metadata; sections without an override still use assigned teacher names.
